title.zh: Grok Bot 与 Agent 助手

lede.zh: 让 Agent 像同事一样接活：从第一天怎么配，到按岗位挑一只 Bot、接上工具和技能，再看别人怎么用一整支小队跑业务。
lede.en: Put an agent to work like a teammate: how to set it up on day one, pick a bot for a role, wire in tools and skills, and see how others run whole teams of bots.

band.zh: 入门、岗位配方、工具技能和真实案例，一页看全。
band.en: Starter guides, role recipes, tools, skills and real teams in one place.
